summary: Connect the CLI and generated clients directly to a remote client API with fabric://<node-or-name>/st3-client-v0 through the local Fabric daemon, without a TCP proxy.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or membership rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds an opt-in Fabric endpoint. Unix and HTTP endpoints retain their existing behavior. Fabric permits only client API and health paths and retains remote client authorization.

downtime.detail: No additional daemon interruption is required by the client transport.

manual.detail: Select fabric://<node-or-name>/st3-client-v0 and run a local Fabric daemon with trust and the remote protocol grant. Trusted peer names must be unique; use a NodeID to disambiguate.

recovery.detail: Return to the previous client or endpoint; no persistent state is migrated.
